the user comparison directly supports better performance in the tested configuration-search setting, while the authors' unverified wine case limits broader field generalization (PDF pp. 9, 11).

(p. 3)

paper_code_entries.value: immediate_performance_or_sensemaking — the support helps users identify promising configurations during the current search (PDF p. 5).
